project.name: shopflow-lsm
project.description: Log-structured merge-tree mini engine: a sorted in-memory memtable that flushes to immutable sorted segments, a read path that scans newest-to-oldest and stops at the first hit (tombstone = not-found), and size-tiered compaction that keeps only the newest version per key and purges tombstones. The write-optimized storage model behind RocksDB/Cassandra/LevelDB. Pure Java, unit-tested.
